ONBOARDING.S1_BODY: Notes for ideas, reminders for deadlines, calendar for events. Private by design, fast by nature.
ONBOARDING.S2_BODY: A reminder has a precise time: you get a push notification and mark it as done. An event has a start and end: you get an alert before it begins.
ONBOARDING.S_VIEWS_BODY: You can swipe anywhere on the screen to switch between views — or use the bottom navigation bar.
ONBOARDING.S3_BODY: The key is generated on your device and never leaves your control. Not even we can access your content.
ONBOARDING.S4_BODY: Every share code includes the encryption key. Without it, nothing is visible. Shared calendars sync in real time.
ONBOARDING.S5_BODY: Use the + button to get started. You can come back here any time from Settings.
ONBOARDING.TYPE_EVENT_HINT: start and end · push notification optional
